sharedRules.name: UCMF Battlenet
sharedRules.description:
An admiral assigned to this ship gains the following Command Abilities:
Telemetry Link (2AP): When you activate another friendly Group in Orbit, that Group increases its total movement (after orders) by 4" this round.
Order to Fire (2AP): When you activate another friendly Group in Orbit, pick one of the following options:
• While that Group is on the General Quarters, Course Change, or Damage Control orders, each Ship may attack with an additional weapon.
• While that Group is on the General Quarters or Weapons Free orders, you may attack with a single allowed Weapon System before turning and moving any Ships in that Group. That Weapon System cannot be used for the rest of the Group's activation.

sharedRules.name: Stealth Drop
sharedRules.description: When this Group launches its Dropships, 2 Dropships are needed to place 1 Battalion. If this Group contains a single ship, each Dropship only places a Battalion on a roll of a 4+.

sharedRules.name: Feature Carrier
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, before players deploy, choose one Deployable Feature from the UCM Deployable Features List. This Ship starts the game carrying that Deployable Feature.

sharedRules.name: UCMA Battlenet
sharedRules.description:
An Admiral assigned to this ship gains the following Command Abilities:
Double Time Bulk Line (2AP): When you activate another friendly Group in Orbit, until the end of its activation, that Group may launch its Bulk Landers as if the target Dropsite has no enemy Battalions.
Feet First into Hell (2AP): When you activate another friendly Group in atmosphere, until the end of its activation, that Group can launch its Dropships or Drop Pods with a range of 6". Drop Pods launched due to this rule ignore the Alt-Launch rule.

characteristics.name: Effect

rules.name: Aegis Platform
rules.description:
Each friendly Aegis Platform counts as a separate friendly Group for the purposes of its Aegis-X special rule. While this feature is deployed to a Dropsite, friendly groups treat the Dropsite as if it were a friendly Ship with Aegis-4 on the same Orbital Layer for the purposes of enemy close action and bomber attacks.
This Feature's Aegis special rule affects friendly Ships in Orbit in addition to Atmosphere.
After enemy assets end their movement within 4", are placed within 4" of, or are deployed to this Dropsite, roll a dice for each of those assets. For each result of a 5+, remove one of those assets. Enemy Features are only removed on a result of a 6+. Only one Aegis Platform can be used this way for each Asset and any Battalions already on the Dropsite are ignored.

rules.name: Comms Platform
rules.description:
Friendly Ships with the Command Ship-X ability within 8" of one or more Dropsites with a friendly Comms Platform improve the X value of that rule by 1 when generating AP.
Friendly Ships within 8" of this Feature's Dropsite ignore the effects of any Scanners Offline token.

rules.name: Torpedo Platform
rules.description: When an attacking Group or Asset/s attack would cause this feature to be removed, if it has any remaining Torpedoes, the attacking opponent may remove one additional Feature and any Battalions assigned to it from this Dropsite.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: After the Battalion Combat step of the Asset Phase, target a Dropsite or Feature. If any enemy Battalions completely removed any friendly Battalions from that Dropsite or Feature, place 1 Battalion on that Dropsite or Feature.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Planning Phase, pick one friendly Group. All Ships in that Group improve their Aegis-X value by 2 or gain Aegis-1 if they do not have the Aegis-X special rule.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Planning Phase, pick one Dropsite within 6" of a friendly Group. That Dropsite takes D3+1 Core hits.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign a Group's weapons to a target, each of the attacking Group's Weapon Systems with "Mass Driver" in their name improve their Lock by 1 for that attack sequence.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Asset Phase, target one friendly Wing of Bombers. That Wing gains the Bombardment special rule until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Planning Phase, target one friendly Group. That Group may re-roll failed Energy Saves until the end of the round.
